scripts.build:debug: ARCH=$(uname -m) && make -C ../serverplugin debug USE_NAPI=1 DDEV_BUILD=1 LOG_LEVEL=2 && tsc -p tsconfig.debug.json && cp ../serverplugin/libserverplugin-darwin-${ARCH}-debug.node ./dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp ../serverplugin/libserverplugin-linux-${ARCH}-debug.node ./dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:release: ARCH=$(uname -m) && make -C ../serverplugin release USE_NAPI=1 DPROD_BUILD=1 LOG_LEVEL=2 && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp ../serverplugin/libserverplugin-darwin-${ARCH}.node ./dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp ../serverplugin/libserverplugin-linux-${ARCH}.node ./dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
